_approach: Percussive, tom-and-conga-driven techno built on a 32nd-note grid the way Attack's Spastik-style Percussive Techno dissection programs its groove: a straight quarter-note kick, a low-velocity 32nd-note snare roll where hits land off the obvious 16th positions for a jittery, manually-nudged feel rather than a global swing, a 16th closed hat, and a reversed-feel open hat placed just before each half-bar. Congas trade a call-and-response line for the tribal, Underground-Resistance-adjacent low end. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
